milestones.title: M0 — Repository and planning
milestones.description: Repo standards, docs, ADRs, CI, scaffolding.

milestones.title: M1 — Nearby discovery
milestones.description: Location inputs, provider interfaces, demo + Google Places discovery.

milestones.title: M3 — Real travel times
milestones.description: Routing provider selection and route-time lookup.

milestones.title: M6 — MVP interface and release hardening
milestones.description: UI, states, a11y, security, Docker, E2E.

issues.title: Establish repository standards and project documentation
issues.outcome: A contributor can understand the project, conventions, and how to work in it from the repo alone.
issues.scope: README, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY, PRD, architecture docs (system-overview, provider-strategy, scoring-and-filtering), runbooks, ADR template, issue/PR templates, CI workflow, codeowners, license.
acceptance: README explains stack, quick start (demo mode), and doc map.
All required docs exist under docs/.
tests: Docs build/lint if any.
CI config parses (yaml valid).

issues.title: Scaffold SvelteKit application and development tooling
issues.outcome: A runnable SvelteKit + Svelte 5 + TS strict skeleton exists with the required source layout.
issues.scope: Create the SvelteKit project (Svelte 5, TS strict), the source layout (lib/{components,domain,engine,providers,server,stores,utilities}, routes, routes/api, tests), package manager config, and base config files.
issues.non_goals: Feature implementation; provider logic; UI screens.
acceptance: App builds and runs in dev.
tests: Smoke: dev server boots.
Build succeeds.

sub_issues.title: Scaffold base SvelteKit project and config
Create source layout and base route shells

issues.title: Configure linting, formatting, type checking, unit tests, and browser smoke tests
issues.outcome: All quality gates are configured and run locally and in CI.
issues.scope: Prettier, ESLint (Svelte), svelte-check (types), Vitest (unit+integration), Playwright (smoke), and npm scripts for each.
acceptance: Playwright config present with one trivial smoke test.
tests: Vitest sample test passes.
Playwright smoke passes locally.

issues.title: Configure GitHub Actions CI
issues.outcome: Every push/PR runs install, format, lint, type check, unit/integration, build, Playwright, and a secret scan.
issues.scope: CI workflow using the committed lockfile, with caching that does not affect correctness, plus a basic secret-scan step and dependency review where supported.
acceptance: CI runs on push to main and PRs.
tests: CI green on this branch.

issues.title: Define normalized domain models
issues.outcome: All normalized domain types exist and are the single source of truth across layers.
issues.scope: Define types: Coordinates, SearchConfiguration, Candidate, PlaceCandidate, EventCandidate, CostEstimate, OpeningWindow, WeatherWindow, TravelEstimate, Plan, PlanStop, PlanGenerationResult, ProviderError, DataConfidence.
issues.non_goals: Provider response types (those stay in adapters).
acceptance: All listed types defined with Zod or TS types.
No provider fields leak into domain types.
tests: Type-level tests / fixtures parse into domain types.

issues.title: Define and validate the search-configuration schema
issues.outcome: User input is validated at the boundary before any pipeline work.
issues.scope: Zod schema for SearchConfiguration (location inputs, time, max travel, mode, budget, indoor/outdoor, energy, categories, party size) with sane defaults and clear errors.
acceptance: Invalid input is rejected with field-level errors.
Valid input normalizes to domain type.
tests: Unit tests for valid + invalid configs.

issues.title: Implement current-location acquisition
issues.outcome: A user can grant browser location to seed the origin.
issues.scope: Geolocation button with explicit user action, explanation, timeout, and permission-denied handling; produces Coordinates.
acceptance: Permission-denied yields a handled state, not a crash.
tests: Unit test the resolver wrapper with a mock geolocation.

issues.title: Implement manually entered location
issues.outcome: A user can type a city/neighborhood/address without granting browser permission.
issues.scope: Text input + geocode via GeocodingProvider; show resolved coordinates/label; allow correction.
issues.non_goals: Map-point selection; live Google dependency in demo mode (fixture used).
acceptance: Typed location resolves to Coordinates or clear error.
tests: Unit test geocode->Coordinates with fixture provider.

issues.title: Implement map-point location selection
issues.outcome: A user can drop a pin on a map to set the origin.
issues.scope: Embedded map, click-to-set Coordinates, reverse-geocode label via GeocodingProvider; optional.
tests: Unit test coordinate extraction; component test for click.

issues.title: Define provider interfaces
issues.outcome: Stable contracts exist so adapters are swappable and the engine depends only on interfaces.
issues.scope: Interfaces: GeocodingProvider, PlacesProvider, EventsProvider, WeatherProvider, RoutingProvider, each with typed inputs/outputs and ProviderError.
acceptance: Interfaces compile and are imported by the engine, not concrete adapters.
tests: Mock adapters satisfy interfaces in tests.

issues.title: Implement deterministic demo providers
issues.outcome: The app runs end-to-end with zero credentials using fixtures.
issues.scope: Fixture implementations of all five provider interfaces with saved sample data and deterministic outputs; selection by config when no keys present.
acceptance: Demo mode returns stable fixture results.
Engine produces 3 plans in demo mode.
tests: Unit tests per fixture adapter against saved fixtures.

issues.title: Implement Google Places nearby search
issues.outcome: Live nearby search returns normalized candidates when a key is configured.
issues.scope: Live adapter for Places (New) Nearby Search; boundary Zod validation; typed errors; timeout + limited retries; normalization to Candidate.
acceptance: Live adapter validates response at boundary.
tests: Tests use saved fixture responses (no live calls).
Verify current field names from official docs at build.

issues.title: Implement Place details and opening-window normalization
issues.outcome: We can enrich a candidate with hours, rating, price level, and geometry.
issues.scope: Place Details (New) adapter; compute OpeningWindow (next open/close) from periods; boundary validation; typed errors.
acceptance: OpeningWindow computed correctly for open/closed/24h cases.
Missing hours handled as low confidence, not crash.
tests: Unit tests for opening-window math across cases.

issues.title: Candidate normalization and deduplication
issues.outcome: Raw candidates become a clean, deduplicated set of normalized Candidates.
issues.scope: Normalize place/event candidates into a common shape; dedupe by id/geo proximity; preserve source confidence.
acceptance: All candidates conform to domain type.
tests: Unit tests for dedupe and normalization.

issues.title: Implement hard-constraint filtering
issues.outcome: Candidates that cannot yield an actionable plan are rejected before ranking.
issues.scope: Implement all hard constraints (closed before arrival, closes before finish, event window, total time, min cost > budget, one-way travel > max, weather unreasonable, missing required data) as pure functions returning rejection reasons.
issues.non_goals: Travel-time constraint (needs routing, M3); final scoring.
acceptance: Each constraint has a unit test including boundary cases.
tests: Unit tests per constraint + combinations.

issues.title: Implement preliminary scoring
issues.outcome: A cheap score ranks candidates so only the strongest ~12 are routed.
issues.scope: Preliminary score from preference/category/energy match, rating/review confidence, novelty, weather suitability, open-now confidence, cost confidence, minus missing-data and duplicate-category penalties.
acceptance: Preliminary score isolates top candidates deterministically.
tests: Unit tests asserting weight effects and determinism.

issues.title: Select and document the routing provider
issues.outcome: The routing provider choice is finalized and recorded.
issues.scope: Write ADR-0004 selecting Google Routes over Mapbox; confirm interface coverage for all travel modes.
tests: ADR review sign-off.

issues.title: Implement route-time lookup for shortlisted candidates
issues.outcome: Shortlisted candidates get real travel estimates.
issues.scope: Google Routes adapter for the top ~12 candidates; boundary validation; timeout + limited retries; TravelEstimate per mode; fixture counterpart.
tests: Tests use saved fixture routes (no live calls).

issues.title: Implement Open-Meteo weather adapter
issues.outcome: Weather windows are available for eligibility and ranking with no API key.
issues.scope: Open-Meteo adapter (keyless) returning WeatherWindow; boundary validation of fields/units; typed errors; timeout; fixture counterpart.
tests: Tests use saved fixture forecasts; verify field/unit shape at build.

issues.title: Implement deterministic weather-suitability rules
issues.outcome: Weather affects eligibility and ranking, not just display.
issues.scope: Pure functions: heavy rain rejects unsheltered outdoor; high heat penalizes exposed midday; strong wind penalizes overlooks/waterfronts/cycling; good conditions boost parks/trails/walks/markets.
acceptance: Each rule has unit tests with clear pass/reject/penalty outcomes.
tests: Unit tests per rule + combinations.

issues.title: Implement final candidate scoring
issues.outcome: A transparent final score combines all signals after routing/weather/budget.
issues.scope: Final score with documented positive/negative weights; travel-time, budget risk, schedule risk, missing-data, duplicate-category, low-confidence penalties; returns score components.
acceptance: Score components returned in dev mode.
tests: Unit tests asserting component contributions and determinism.

issues.title: Implement three-plan diversity selection
issues.outcome: Exactly three diverse plans are produced, or an explicit insufficiency result.
issues.scope: Selection roles: best overall, lowest-cost/friction, highest-novelty; category/experience diversity rules; structured insufficiency when <3 viable; never invent places.
acceptance: Three distinct plans when viable exist.
tests: Unit tests for diversity, ties, and insufficiency.

issues.title: Build the search-form interface
issues.outcome: Users can enter all required inputs through an accessible form.
issues.scope: Form for location (3 modes), time, max travel, mode, budget, indoor/outdoor, energy, categories, party size; client validation; a11y.
tests: Component tests for validation and a11y.

issues.title: Build the plan-results interface
issues.outcome: The three plans are presented with all required fields and reasons.
issues.scope: Results view rendering each plan's fields, reasons, warnings, confidence; navigable to map links.
tests: Component tests for rendering + a11y.

issues.title: Add map-navigation links
issues.outcome: Each plan offers a navigation action to the destination.
issues.scope: Generate provider-agnostic navigation deep links (e.g., geo: / maps URL) from destination Coordinates; open in maps app.
issues.non_goals: In-app map rendering of the route.
acceptance: Navigation link uses destination coordinates only.
tests: Unit test link construction.

issues.title: Implement empty, partial, error, permission-denied, and degraded-provider states
issues.outcome: The app degrades gracefully across all failure and partial-data states.
issues.scope: States: no results, partial provider failure, hard error, geolocation denied, degraded provider (e.g., weather unavailable). Each shows clear messaging and next action.
acceptance: Each state has a defined UI and copy.
tests: Component tests per state.

issues.title: Add accessibility verification
issues.outcome: The MVP meets baseline accessibility standards.
issues.scope: Keyboard nav, focus management, ARIA roles/labels, color contrast, reduced-motion; verify with automated + manual checks.
acceptance: Automated a11y checks pass on key screens.
tests: Playwright a11y smoke tests.

issues.title: Add privacy and security review
issues.outcome: The MVP meets the stated privacy and security bar before release.
issues.scope: Review: server-only keys, no client exposure, location privacy (explicit grant, manual option, no persistence), no committed secrets, provider responses validated.
acceptance: No key reaches the client bundle.
tests: CI secret scan green.
Manual review checklist signed off.

issues.title: Add Docker deployment
issues.outcome: The app builds and runs as a container for deployment.
issues.scope: Dockerfile (node:22-alpine, SvelteKit Node adapter), .dockerignore, run instructions; HTTPS noted as deploy concern.
issues.non_goals: Orchestration, ingress, secrets management (env at runtime).
acceptance: Image builds and serves the app.
tests: Build the image in CI or locally; smoke curl.

issues.title: Perform MVP end-to-end acceptance testing
issues.outcome: The full pipeline is verified end-to-end in demo and (optionally) live mode.
issues.scope: End-to-end scenario: input -> 3 plans; plus degraded/empty/insufficiency paths; Playwright smoke; demo-mode CI.
tests: Playwright E2E covering core flow + edge states.

issues.title: Add Ticketmaster events as post-MVP work
issues.outcome: Events become a candidate source alongside places.
issues.scope: Ticketmaster adapter behind EventsProvider; normalization to EventCandidate; boundary validation; fixture counterpart; integrate into pipeline after MVP.
acceptance: Event candidates normalize and dedupe with places.
tests: Tests use saved fixture events (no live calls).

issues.title: Add lightweight preference feedback as post-MVP work
issues.outcome: The app can learn mild preferences from plan choices (no accounts).
issues.scope: Optional client-side preference signal (e.g., chosen category/energy) fed back into scoring weights; no persistence beyond session unless specified.
tests: Unit tests for feedback->weight effect.
